The industry performance statistics contains aggregate summaries of financial performance and position, asset allocation and key performance ratios. Statistics relating to corporate, industry, public sector and retail funds performance are also detailed. The MySuper statistics contains data relating to product profile, asset allocation targets and ranges, investment performance and net returns, as well as fees and costs. Statistics are presented at an individual product or lifecycle stage level. publications.title: 47th Half-Yearly Report on Management of Foreign Exchange Reserves: April – September 2026
publications.summary: It may be recalled that in February 2004 , the Reserve Bank initiated the practice of compiling half-yearly reports on the management of foreign exchange reserves and making them public to promote greater transparency and enhance disclosure in the management of the country's foreign exchange reserves. In this connection, Reserve Bank of India has today released the 47th Half-Yearly Report on Management of Foreign Exchange Reserves with reference to end-September 2026. During April-September 2026, India's foreign exchange reserves increased from US$ 691.11 billion to US$ 737.78 billion. The latest position of India's foreign exchange reserves is available at the following link: https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/WSSView.aspx?Id=28849 (Brij Raj) Chief General Manager Press Release: 2026-2027/1564

publications.title: How should investors evaluate performance?
publications.summary: Why fund performance needs a detailed review in concentrated marketsA fund’s headline return tells only part of the story. Before selling a fund that has underperformed its benchmark, investors should ask why and whether it still meets their needs.This matters when a small group of companies dominate stock market returns. A fund that spreads its investments more widely may underperform a concentrated index. That does not necessarily mean its manager has made poor decisions. Equally, diversification should not become an excuse for weak stock picking.There could also be a big impact on pensions, which play a vital role in people’s financial futures. We want pension schemes to deliver long-term value for savers. Firms and asset owners should look at the bigger picture, including a fund manager’s stated investment objective, strategy and style.How market concentration makes a real difference

publications.title: FINMA assesses UBS’s crisis preparations
publications.summary: In its annual assessment of UBS’s crisis plans, the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority FINMA notes that UBS’s resolvability improved in 2025 as a result of the advanced integration of Credit Suisse. FINMA considers the preferred resolution strategy (recapitalisation, restructuring and continuation of a restructured UBS) to be executable. In addition, progress has been made in integrating the emergency plan into Group-wide resolution planning. FINMA has approved the recovery plan submitted by UBS in 2025.
